works.body:
Hello Shiba!
I am absolutely enchanted by your art and I am looking for something special for a DnD event. It is quite an extensive request, but I truly hope you might enjoy bringing it to life.

I would love to commission 6 separate character illustrations. Extra Outfits and references are attached.
	•	Jeevy (Warlock): A moonshadow elf with horns, long violet hair, and a flowing black robe with glowing tattoos.
	•	Tshii (Bard): Plays a harp, has black and green hair tied into a braid, and cat ears.
	•	Nyan (Tabaxi Warrior): An orange, black, and white spotted Tabaxi who walks upright. She wears her crown along with a typical warrior’s armor.
	•	Karihina (Mage): Has long twisted pink braids and long fox ears.
	•	Yusaki (Druid/Fae): A small fairy, only reaching about hip height compared to the others. She has a horn on her forehead and short pink hair.
	•	Blieb (Dungeon Master): A dragon kobold player character. He is rather weak, with firm dolphin-like skin and horned ears.

https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1s5dQY_IBqlU-KwRFFmgzinRHxFT97G-O

Hello, nice to meet you.
I have seen your new illustrations at https://skeb.jp/@Shibazakie_/works/10

I was strongly attracted by the high quality of your illustrations and past works,
I was very much interested in having her illustration done.

I know this is a bit geeky, but I would like to ask you to draw the following character for me.
The following is a reference image, but you are free to design the sailor uniform, expression, pose, and composition.
https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1RIJ2bUUoPHZDhYmSZ5NlFco0yYrqRyDg?usp=sharing

Below is the content of the request.

Girl
She has glossy black hair with bangs, a short bob that is slightly curled inward, side and back hair trimmed at about the mouth line, and a softly cropped collar (depending on the composition, it may or may not be visible).
Sailor uniform with short sleeves
Short-sleeved sailor uniform
Situation
The right arm is in a cast and is hanging from the neck with a triangular bandage.
　-Please place the knot of the triangular bandage at the neck and elbow in a visible position (please refer to the URL of the document).
　　(This is a minor detail, but there is a difference: the neck has one knot and two ends of the triangular bandage, while the elbow has one knot and one end of the triangular bandage.)
　-Please make sure that the right arm is in the frame.
One adhesive bandage on the cheek.
-An expression of embarrassment, not darkened by the injury, as shown below.
　Wink with one eye, tongue sticking out, so-called "tehepero" expression.

My personal point is to moe the bandage and still look cute and energetic.

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=iLDkTBdxs4w

Hello, nice to meet you. I'd like you to draw an artwork for me please. Sorry for my bad Japanese.

Are you familiar with the "gold week bikini" trend that happened about 2 months ago? It's where artists draw girls in golden bikinis to celebrate "golden week" in Japan.

You can see examples of the golden bikini here: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1hNAF6JswTDryMHvFeiBsnBAX66MbtnGy?usp=drive_link

So I'd like you to draw my character named Quetzal wearing a golden bikini. You can pose her how you want to. I'd like her to be happy and enjoying her summer vacation. Please include a beach background as well if possible.

Quetzal's references: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1zm-2BFEYDr4jmT7b_9WrJQKVi8BX3Z5I?usp=drive_link

In some of the images, her hair looks black. Her hair color is meant to be a dark brown.

Thank you very much for your consideration.
